## `neuro.dataView.setUint32`

Instance method on `DataView.prototype`.

> Stores an Uint32 value at the specified byte offset from the start of the view.

## Signatures

```ts
setUint32(input: { dataView: <receiver>; byteOffset: number; value: number; littleEndian?: boolean; prompt?: string }): Promise<void>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `DataView.prototype.setUint32` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
